# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# GVI local development environment variables (Mac Studio / Docker Compose)
# Copy this file to .env.local and fill in the values.
# .env.local is excluded from commits via .gitignore.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

NODE_ENV=development
PORT=3010

# ── App basics ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
VITE_APP_ID=gvi-local

# JWT session signing key (min 32 chars; any string is fine for local dev)
JWT_SECRET=local-dev-secret-change-this-in-production-!!

# ── Database (mysql service in docker-compose) ───────────────────
DATABASE_URL=mysql://gvi_user:gvi_password@localhost:3307/gvi

# ── S3-compatible storage (minio service in docker-compose) ──────
AWS_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:9000
AWS_REGION=us-east-1
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=gvi_minio_user
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=gvi_minio_password
AWS_BUCKET=gvi-storage
# URL the browser uses to access files (MinIO presigned URLs use this address)
AWS_PUBLIC_URL=http://localhost:9000/gvi-storage

# ── Local dev login bypass ────────────────────────────────────────
# Set to true to activate the /api/dev/login endpoint.
# Ignored when NODE_ENV=production.
DEV_AUTH=true
# Client UI flag for the Dev Login form (must match DEV_AUTH for local bypass).
VITE_DEV_AUTH=true

# ── Google (Gmail) OAuth ──────────────────────────────────────────
# Create a Web application OAuth client in Google Cloud Console:
#   APIs & Services → Credentials → Create OAuth client ID
# Authorized redirect URI (local):
#   http://localhost:3010/api/auth/google/callback
# GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=
# GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=
# Optional exact redirect override (defaults to request host + /api/auth/google/callback)
# GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI=http://localhost:3010/api/auth/google/callback
# Show "Continue with Google" on the login screen (set true after credentials above).
# VITE_GOOGLE_AUTH=true

# ── AI Copilot (optional) ─────────────────────────────────────────
# OpenAI-compatible chat completions base URL + API key
# LLM_API_URL=https://api.openai.com
# LLM_API_KEY=

# ── Site Gateway (optional) ───────────────────────────────────────
# Set when integrating with an internal gx-daemon (min 32 chars)
# GVI_GATEWAY_TOKEN=
